metric: Deliberately broken multi-model refactors (filter moved across an outer join or aggregate, extracted model that changes an exposed intermediate, wrong rollup, join type changed) shown different by a database on which an output differs.
correctness: 0 wrong: no sound refactor is called different. Each counterexample is a database replayed through both full pipelines in DuckDB; 15 come from the prover's counterexample, 51 from a random-database search.
held_out: 10/10 refuted (union_split and latest_per_key families, run once at baseline)
caveats: Bounded by the databases tried (25 random ones), so a subtle break could escape; every case here is caught. Generated cases, none adapted from a public suite yet.
